Homeland Security and Public Safety

Homeland Security and Public Safety

RAND conducts research and analysis on homeland security issues such as border and port security, critical infrastructure protection, cybersecurity, disaster management and recovery, and Arctic policy. In the area of public safety, RAND addresses drug policy, emergency preparedness, crime, school safety, and other topics.
